criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.
Given the data files, when any tab renders, then its content comes from .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json read at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given .colaberry/manifest.json, when any tab is shown, then it displays how old the data is and warns when that age exceeds a week.
Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.
Given a production change request, when the request is submitted, then it must require human approval.
Given a denied approval, when the request is resubmitted unchanged, then it must still require approval.
Every approval decision (approve or deny) is logged for audit, keyed by correlation ID.

note_totals: stories_total/stories_verified count the 11 real programme stories (plan.stories); criteria_total/criteria_passed reflect STORY-000 and STORY-001's criteria, since those are the only two stories with acceptance criteria defined so far — this will expand as later stories get built. 'submitted' means the criteria are backed by passing tests but no reviewer/commit sign-off has moved the story to 'verified' yet.

r2McpServer.description: MCP server built on the official @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, run over stdio (index.ts) and a thin HTTP wrapper (httpServer.ts) for local verification. One read-only resource + tool: read_sql_server_dmv, backed by dmvReader.ts/dmvLiveSource.ts, parameterized and honestly fixture-fallback when no live SQL Server is connected.

r4Guardrail.description: checkRemediationGuardrail() rejects any remediation missing evidence, an allowed action type, or an approved (not denied, not absent) human decision.

story001ApprovalAudit.description: buildApprovalAuditEntry() + ApprovalAuditLog record every approve/deny decision, keyed by correlation ID, idempotent on repeat (STORY-001 criterion 3). Covers the approval-decision slice of REQ-005's full audit trail, not the whole trail — that's STORY-002.
